context: Request: all closed deals of the M&A practice with signing and closing dates (time-to-close benchmark). Rubric: 15 matters (1001-00003, 1001-00007, 1003-00003, 1005-00006, 1006-00007, 1008-00008, 1009-00003, 1013-00006, 1015-00004, 1017-00006, 1037-00006, 1039-00004, 1041-00003, 1042-00004, 1046-00001) with exact dates, plus a precision criterion whose judge text names 1036-00004 and fails T0/T2 for asserting 1046-00001 (passed by C-015).

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Whole-store glob plus PDF and DOCX globs; the PDF glob returns nothing.

stages.stage: Read documents picked from the file listing
stages.note: Two batches of reads (agreements, memos, spreadsheets, emails) from three matters at the top of the listing.

stages.stage: Calculate figures for the answer
stages.note: Date arithmetic for one deal.

stages.stage: Read documents picked from the file listing
stages.note: Re-reads an engagement letter, a closing checklist and a memo of the same matters.

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Writes one closed deal from the listing-top matters as the only one.

stages.stage: Finish the run
stages.note: Calls finish.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → Read documents picked from the file listing → Calculate figures for the answer → Read documents picked from the file listing → Write the response → Finish the run
runs.failure_point: Never searched; reported the one closed deal visible at the top of the listing.

first_error.stage: Read documents picked from the file listing
first_error.why: Chose what to read from the few matters in a capped listing without any search, so fourteen of the closed deals never surfaced.

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Whole-store glob plus a shell find limited to three levels (empty).

stages.stage: List matter folders
stages.note: Lists all matter folders and subfolders; about 92K chars.

stages.stage: Search file names for request keywords
stages.note: Script listing matters that have both transaction and closing subfolders, with their files; about 109K chars.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Store-wide .docx scan for files stating both signing and closing dates; about 363K chars.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Reads agreements, a checklist, a closing package and a memo of six candidate matters.

stages.stage: Search within a candidate matter's files
stages.note: Snippet script printing date lines from documents and emails of 22 named candidate matters; about 273K chars.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Two batches of short reads (agreements, emails, checklists, a certificate) across candidates plus a glob to locate one memo; one path does not exist.

stages.stage: Calculate figures for the answer
stages.note: Date arithmetic for 15 deals.

stages.stage: Read a chosen matter's documents in depth
stages.note: Reads the opening of one agreement to confirm its date.

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Writes 14 closed deals with signing and closing dates and elapsed days.

stages.stage: Check or revise the response
stages.note: Edits: adds one deal and updates statistics, sources and exclusions.

stages.stage: Finish the run
stages.note: Calls finish.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → List matter folders → Search file names for request keywords → Scan document text with an extraction script → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Search within a candidate matter's files → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Calculate figures for the answer → Read a chosen matter's documents in depth → Write the response → Check or revise the response → Finish the run
runs.failure_point: Found 13 of 15 deals; two surfaced matters were never opened and one closing date came from a filing certificate.

first_error.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
first_error.why: Its subfolder filter and .docx scan both listed two matters it needed, but its first reads and its 22-matter candidate list left them out, so they were never opened and are missing from the answer.

other_errors.why: For one deal it took the filing date of a certificate of merger as the closing date, four days before the closing date the rubric expects (evidence seen at [27]-[28]).

divergence: T0 and T2 failed the same way: they never searched, read only the matters at the top of the capped listing and reported one closed deal (partial listing as corpus at the reading stage). T1 searched broadly and found 13 of 15, but left two surfaced matters out of what it opened (surfaced not opened at the first screening stage) and took one closing date from a filing certificate.
